lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, Line 22, column (ii), 'enter the amount of the QPVLI, if any, that was deducted elsewhere on your return (for example, on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F)'. As in the earlier rulings on this line: Schedule F and Schedule E business or K-1 income are refused through the return's scope screens (scope.farm, scope.k1), and a rental's car or truck expenses are refused (rental.vehicle, Schedule E line 6, auto and travel), so Schedule C is the only place a supported return deducts this loan's interest.
